hypothesis: Original verification changes observation viewpoints while collecting stability evidence and loses DONE immediately after a missing observation. Freeze each observation pose, collect only after measured robot arrival/settling, and hold the confirmed view under an explicit short evidence-age bound.
unchanged: The same learned capsule/fixture containment, height, tilt, minimum sample count, 0.4 s stable window, 3 mm/3 degree stability and synchronized-pair gates apply. Physical success evaluator, robot physics and original grasp/placement motion are unchanged. Ambiguity requests another view rather than automatically regrasping a possibly correct placement.
boundary: Only detached learned estimates and robot proprioception. No actual containment, support/contact, evaluator result, object pose or true scene state enters inspection. The independent strict released/supported/stable placement evaluator remains the sole primary success metric.
freeze: Freeze before v14 full episodes. Baseline and all variants retain the same 30-second episode limit. Three known development scenes precede fresh scenes; defer unused fresh collection while implementation issues remain. Preserve v11/v13 and mechanical-probe outcomes independently.
scope: Engineering temporal-evidence correction and component ablation, not established research novelty. Short bounded confirmation is not a new positive measurement or proof against future changes. Any accepted but physically incorrect DONE remains a recorded failure.
